authority.originals: Google Drive or authenticated provider remains primary
authority.geometry: admitted and versioned project-model JSON from authenticated architectural source
authority.derived: GitHub versioned read-only data, graphics and CI outputs
authority.construction: Requires owner, responsible engineer and jurisdictional sign-off, not inferred by this template

principles.north: Project identity, chapters, phase and view
principles.south: Unique unresolved review issues and sequential gate navigation, NOT a second chapter or package list
principles.centre: Linked floor plan and 3D, selected model objects and domain details

principles.requirement: For every newly admitted plan, register source-evidenced letter/number axes (A, B, C... and 1, 2, 3...), with stable intersecting IDs A1, B2 ...; if no source-evidenced axes exist, render AXES_NOT_ADMITTED and block semantic structural coordinates. Coordinates are not structural approvals.

100 mm local coordinate/cursor grid is a measurement aid, NOT column axes. A display-only proposed column marker can be axis-labelled but must retain unverified status; never create columns at unused intersections.

A chapter or derivative must carry one edition, source revision/fingerprint, floor, coordinate frame, axis register/status, object/element IDs, units, assumptions and holds; missing evidence is null / HOLD not zero or PASS.
Views, BOQ, Gantt and site packages reference original member/axis IDs by sourceRef, no separate competing axis naming or unrelated approval.

displayRules: 2D: both-ended dashed line bubbles + actual existing element IDs, independent 100 mm coordinate layer
3D: same selected element ID and floor axis metadata in inspector
BOQ: per-member quantities reference axis pair, floor and calculation-source revision or remain UNKNOWN
Programme: activities link element IDs/axis range, predecessor IDs and source dates; never create durations
Packages: stage scope uses same axis range, inspection HOLD and source refs
Sources: show original file, fingerprint, edition, coordinate registration and approval evidence

blockIf: unapproved BBS or mixes passed as actual
new package inferred from empty taxonomy
